method.name: Mixture of Experts
method.principle: Independent expert families transform the same attributable Outliner observations; integration preserves convergence, disagreement, and falsifiers.

experts.label: Orientation & Control Expert
experts.mission: Identify the new state and valid feedback signal after real closures.
assumptions: Task completion dates represent genuine user-recorded outcomes.
The IRS status task is the next tax feedback request.
derivation: Three completed commands should leave the active controller.
The new portal check is one feedback sample, not a reopened chain.
experts.proposal: Read the IRS state once, save it, and issue no new tax command unless the state requires one.
risks: Completed labels may lack external artifacts.
experts.falsified_by: The portal state has no relation to the completed filing work or the old tasks reopen.

experts.label: Decision & Risk Expert
experts.mission: Preserve optionality and prevent a completion burst from becoming overconfidence.
assumptions: One burst changes the prior but is not a stable rate.
AR-11 and internet remain valid open obligations.
derivation: Three closures falsify the strongest zero-action narrative.
Outcome location does not prove the prior controller was wrong when its gate is not due.
experts.proposal: Take the low-cost IRS information bet, then return to shared obligations; keep health as an exception signal.
risks: Burst completion may be batch bookkeeping.
A hidden official deadline could change sequence.
experts.falsified_by: Repeated follow-up shows no attributable external progress or a documented higher-consequence exception appears.

experts.label: Execution Systems Expert
experts.mission: Turn the changed portfolio into a short WIP=1 action path.
assumptions: Only one hands-on action is active at a time.
External waiting may overlap after a request exists.
derivation: The bottleneck advanced from starting tax work to reading its new state.
experts.proposal: Run IRS status, AR-11, then internet; stop each block at a verified state or exact blocker.
risks: Task titles omit deadlines and effort.
Intermediate work may not be recorded.
experts.falsified_by: The sequence repeatedly yields no new state while another documented bottleneck explains delay.

syntheses.title: Close → Observe → Recommit
syntheses.model: Information Theory · Control Theory · Bayesian Updating · Thinking in Bets · Theory of Constraints · OODA Loop · Little's Law
syntheses.problem: Real tax output changed the portfolio, but the old controller still describes a zero-output world and the new filing state is unknown.
syntheses.solution: All experts converge on a clean handoff: remove completed tax work from active attention, take one bounded IRS status sample, then recommit to AR-11 and internet. Decision-risk preserves the minority safeguard that one burst is not a stable base rate and health or official-deadline evidence can override.

context_applications.label: Orientation & Control
context_applications.application: The tax chain is finished in Outliner; the only current tax question is what the IRS now reports.
context_applications.decision_implication: Do not reopen completed steps; inspect the new state once.

context_applications.label: Decision & Risk
context_applications.application: Three closures are meaningful evidence of action, but not proof that every backlog will now flow or that fixed cueing caused it.
context_applications.decision_implication: Buy information cheaply, then preserve the shared obligations and exception rules.

context_applications.label: Execution Systems
context_applications.application: The immediate personal win is a handoff from finished tax work into one status artifact, followed by one named obligation at a time.
context_applications.decision_implication: Run IRS → AR-11 → internet with a verified state at each boundary.

context_decision.choice: Sequence one IRS status check before AR-11 and internet.
context_decision.why: It closes the feedback loop created by the tax burst at low cost.
context_decision.alternative: Ignore the status check and proceed directly to AR-11; this preserves time but leaves filing state unknown.
context_decision.review: Stop tax work after the portal state is saved unless it names a specific next obligation.

context_actions.label: Check IRS filing status
context_actions.move: Capture the current state and any exact next requirement.
context_actions.done_when: Timestamped status or exact access blocker exists.

context_actions.done_when: Resolved warning or provider ticket exists.

syntheses.disagreement: Control favors immediate feedback; decision-risk warns against treating one completion burst as a durable throughput shift. The sequence takes the feedback sample but preserves cautious forecasts.

syntheses.title: Cue Identity Is an Attribution Aid, Not a Prerequisite
syntheses.problem: Prior guidance risked treating task-ID cue coverage as necessary for execution.
syntheses.solution: Keep task identity for attribution and review, but do not confuse a missing cue with inability to act. Useful output occurred with zero cue coverage.

context_applications.label: Information
context_applications.application: A task ID improves routing and auditability, but the completion burst proves action can originate elsewhere.
context_applications.decision_implication: Use exact IDs in the new queue without making cue coverage a causal requirement.

context_applications.label: Bayesian
context_applications.application: Observed output lowers belief in cue alignment as a necessary condition while leaving its helpfulness unresolved.
context_applications.decision_implication: Keep the schedule-alignment test pending through 2026-08-02.

context_decision.choice: Use task IDs for attribution, not as a gate on valid outcomes.
context_decision.why: This preserves auditability without discarding real action outside the cue channel.
context_decision.alternative: Require schedule alignment before counting action; that would misclassify three completions.
context_decision.review: Weaken further if eligible artifacts repeatedly occur without aligned cues through 2026-08-02.

context_actions.label: Use one exact task identity

context_actions.done_when: Its next state is attributable to this task ID.

position.headline: Protect the breakthrough: turn a burst of closure into a repeatable finish–observe–choose rhythm.
position.summary: Your Outliner no longer supports a zero-action story: three tax tasks closed in one day and a clean monitoring task appeared next. The strategic tension is that this output happened outside the protected queue, so the best move is neither celebration-as-certainty nor rigid loyalty to the old plan. Read the new tax state once, close two shared obligations, then invest recovered attention in one health or growth option.
position.momentum: Special-cause positive: real closures reduced eligible WIP 9→7.
position.tension: A completion burst changed reality, but one day is not yet a stable execution rate.
position.leverage: A clean feedback handoff prevents completed work from remaining mentally active and turns every result into a better next choice.
position.confidence: Medium-high on the state change; medium on whether it will repeat.

winning_moves.title: Seal the tax win with one status read
winning_moves.move: Check the IRS portal once, record the state, and continue tax work only if it names a real obligation.
winning_moves.why_now: Three closures created a new information gate within hours.
unlocks: Confidence that the chain reached the outside world
A finite tax state instead of background uncertainty
winning_moves.tradeoff: Uses one short block before other obligations.
winning_moves.win_condition: Timestamped filing status or exact access blocker exists.

winning_moves.title: Convert the burst into two independent closures
winning_moves.move: Advance AR-11, then resolve or ticket the internet warning; end each block at a verifiable state.
winning_moves.why_now: A second life domain must move before the tax burst can count as repeatable throughput.
unlocks: Evidence the rhythm transfers beyond Taxes
winning_moves.tradeoff: Lung scheduling and expansion options stay deferred absent an exception.
winning_moves.win_condition: Both tasks have confirmations, tickets, exact requirements, or precise blockers; at least one materially advances.

winning_moves.title: Exercise one option, not every ambition
winning_moves.move: After the immediate gate, deliberately select at most one of lung scheduling, travel, or bounded hair research using real timing and consequence evidence.
winning_moves.why_now: Your strategy needs expansion after maintenance, but activating every option would erase the new WIP gain.
winning_moves.tradeoff: Two valid options remain inactive by choice.
winning_moves.win_condition: One option is explicitly active with a bounded outcome; the others remain intentionally preserved.

hidden_leverage.title: Completion changes the right question
hidden_leverage.insight: After three tax closures, the useful question changed from “how do I start?” to “what does the system report now?”
hidden_leverage.why_it_matters: Staying in initiation mode after an outcome wastes the information the outcome created.
hidden_leverage.mechanism: Feedback control retires completed commands and samples the new state before issuing another.
hidden_leverage.falsifier: The status check provides no decision-relevant state or the tasks reopen because completion was only bookkeeping.

hidden_leverage.title: The old controller can miss progress without being useless
hidden_leverage.insight: Zero of three selected actions closed, yet three other eligible tasks did; selected-action adherence and whole-life output are different metrics.
hidden_leverage.why_it_matters: You can learn from a plan miss without erasing real progress or pretending the plan predicted it.
hidden_leverage.mechanism: Bayesian updating separates outcome evidence from intervention attribution.
hidden_leverage.falsifier: The tax completion labels lack real artifacts or later revert.

hidden_leverage.title: Real WIP reduction creates option value
hidden_leverage.insight: The 9→7 decline is attributable to three exits and one arrival, so recovered attention can be allocated rather than merely relabeled.
hidden_leverage.why_it_matters: The gain should buy either closure in another domain or one chosen expansion option—not automatic backlog refill.
hidden_leverage.mechanism: Little’s Law lowers carrying inventory; Thinking in Bets preserves optionality by activating one choice.
hidden_leverage.falsifier: Completed tax work reopens or the lower eligible count produces no usable attention across two cycles.

timeline.label: Now
timeline.objective: Capture IRS state, advance AR-11, and resolve or ticket internet.
timeline.win_condition: Three verified states or blockers; at least one non-tax task materially advances.
timeline.pivot_if: Documented health, safety, legal, financial, or explicit-user priority evidence appears.

timeline.label: This Cycle
timeline.objective: Test whether closure transfers beyond the tax burst while keeping active WIP at one.
timeline.win_condition: At least two attributable current-action outcomes and one explicit option decision.
timeline.pivot_if: The IRS creates a concrete obligation or repeated blockers identify a different constraint.

timeline.label: Horizon
timeline.objective: Scale only the execution pattern that repeatedly produces verified external states.
timeline.win_condition: One chosen health or growth option reaches a bounded outcome without rebuilding portfolio sprawl.
timeline.pivot_if: Two cycles fail to reproduce closure or a dominant official deadline creates a critical path.

pivot_signals.signal: IRS portal names a specific action or unresolved filing issue.
pivot_signals.meaning: Tax remains active despite the three closures.
pivot_signals.response: Follow only the stated next obligation before expansion.

pivot_signals.signal: A clinician or provider supplies urgency, referral, or long lead-time evidence for the lung scan.
pivot_signals.meaning: Health may legitimately override the current sequence.
pivot_signals.response: Move the lung task forward and defer a lower-consequence option.

pivot_signals.signal: AR-11 or internet reaches a verified external state.
pivot_signals.meaning: The closure rhythm transferred beyond Taxes.
pivot_signals.response: Strengthen the handoff model and open one option slot.

pivot_signals.signal: The three tax tasks reopen or lack corresponding external progress.
pivot_signals.meaning: The apparent burst may be bookkeeping rather than closure.
pivot_signals.response: Downgrade the insight and re-establish the actual tax state.

reasoning_provenance.summary: Observed state changes were routed independently through orientation/control, decision/risk, and execution-systems experts; causal claims remain bounded.
reasoning_provenance.evidence_scope: Verified 180-node Outliner mirror, complete known-context notes, targeted full node pages, dashboard history, calibration, and 11 durable connections.
uncertainty: No prior immutable wiki snapshot was available; delta baseline uses the prior deployed run plus native timestamps.
Task completion dates do not prove external artifacts exist.
Unknown note contexts and binary attachments cannot be enumerated by the API.
